# Rio Dental & Orthodontics

> Rio Dental & Orthodontics is a family-focused dental practice serving the Dallas-Fort Worth area with specialized pediatric, family, preventive, restorative, and orthodontic care.

With multiple locations across Dallas, Fort Worth, Irving, Farmers Branch, and Mesquite, Rio Dental provides comprehensive dental services for children and families, featuring board-certified dentists and orthodontists. The practice emphasizes kid-friendly care, preventive dentistry, and accepts Medicaid and CHIP insurance.

- [Family Dentistry in Dallas Fort Worth](https://www.riodentalgroup.com/family-dentistry): Family dentistry services for all ages in Dallas-Fort Worth area
- [Preventative Dentistry for the DFW Area](https://www.riodentalgroup.com/preventive-dentistry): Preventive services: cleanings, fluoride, sealants, gum disease prevention
- [Restorative Dentistry at Rio Dental & Orthodontics](https://www.riodentalgroup.com/restorative-dentistry): Restorative services: crowns, fillings, implants, root canal therapy

## Preventive Care Services

- [Pediatric Dental Checkups & Cleanings](https://www.riodentalgroup.com/childrens-dentistry/checkups-cleanings): Pediatric checkups and cleanings with gentle digital X-ray technology
- [Fluoride Treatment Irving, Farmers Branch, Dallas & Fort Worth, TX](https://www.riodentalgroup.com/preventative-dentistry/fluoride-treatment): Fluoride treatment for cavity prevention in children and families
- [Pediatric Dental Sealants](https://www.riodentalgroup.com/preventive-dentistry/dental-sealants): Dental sealants for cavity prevention and protection of children's teeth
- [Oral Cancer Screenings in Texas](https://www.riodentalgroup.com/preventative-dentistry/oral-cancer-screenings): Oral cancer screenings for all ages at Rio Dental locations
- [Gum Disease Treatment](https://www.riodentalgroup.com/preventative-dentistry/gum-disease-treatment): Gum disease and gingivitis treatment for children and families
- [Comfortable and Safe Dental X-Rays](https://www.riodentalgroup.com/preventive-dentistry/dental-xrays): Digital dental X-rays: panoramic, wisdom teeth, and safe imaging technology

## Restorative & Cosmetic Services

- [Dental Crowns and Bridges for All Ages](https://www.riodentalgroup.com/restorative-dentistry/dental-crowns-and-bridges): Dental crowns and bridges for tooth restoration in children and families
- [Tooth-Colored Fillings for Your Child](https://www.riodentalgroup.com/childrens-dentistry/tooth-colored-fillings): Tooth-colored composite fillings for cavity repair in children
